material_finding: Current Forge->Distillery replay semantics are stable across volatile envelope fields, but the canonical bridge still performs replay lookup before acquiring explicit SQLite write intent. Concurrent ingestors can therefore both observe absence and race at the UNIQUE replay-identity index, leaking an IntegrityError instead of deterministic DUPLICATE/conflict semantics.
counterhypothesis: The UNIQUE replay-identity index alone is sufficient because SQLite will serialize the later INSERTs without changing externally visible semantics.

discriminator_already_on_main.finding: SELECT-before-write can race into one INSERT plus one integrity error; BEGIN IMMEDIATE before lookup serializes the competing writers so the later observer can resolve as duplicate.
